tool_args.rationale: The earlier confirmation failed at Python parsing, not on predictive evidence. Fit the saturating field and gradient-siphon parameters numerically, using leave-one-out errors to choose between the recalled baseline and modest smooth extensions, then request fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fixed-form saturating field with bounded gradient suppression
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Retained as the simplest candidate; cross-validation compares it with two modest extensions.
The observations show substantial gradient-dependent suppression alongside a concave input response, which neither recalled form captures directly.
Nine observations are available after both relevant probes; a fresh confirmation is more informative than repeating measurements.
All observed gradients are below the recalled supercritical range, so its threshold and strength are not identifiable from these observations.
